cohort: 98 mothers in a public maternity unit of a hospital in a Brazilian metropolis, with a mean age of 25.4 ± 6.8 years and a postpartum time of 2.5 ± 1.2 days
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was associated with higher per capita income, cesarean delivery, lower limbs edema, and excess weight before pregnancy, but not with eating habits.
mod_finding: Mothers who had cesarean deliveries had a higher prevalence of excessive GWG.
